papers.title: The cyclic deformation behavior and microstructural evolution of 304L steel manufactured by selective laser melting under various temperatures
papers.first_author_affiliation: Failure Mechanics and Engineering Disaster Prevention Key Laboratory of Sichuan Province, College of Architecture and Environment, Sichuan University, Chengdu, 610065, China

corresponding_authors.name: Hong Zhang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Failure Mechanics and Engineering Disaster Prevention Key Laboratory of Sichuan Province, College of Architecture and Environment, Sichuan University, Chengdu, 610065, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM制备的304L钢在不同温度下的循环变形行为，未涉及生物医学植入物材料、多孔结构或应力屏蔽。
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies cyclic deformation of 304L steel for structural applications, not biomedical implant materials (e.g., Ti alloys), with no porous structures, stress shielding analysis, fatigue for biomedical context, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM 304L钢在不同温度下的循环变形行为。
summary_zh.method: 通过应变控制疲劳实验和微观表征分析。
summary_zh.result: 发现温度影响循环硬化和微观组织演变。
summary_zh.validation: 实验力学测试与微观结构观察。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the cyclic deformation behavior and microstructural evolution of 304L steel fabricated by selective laser melting under various temperatures.
summary_en.method: Strain-controlled fatigue tests combined with microstructural characterization (EBSD, TEM) were conducted.
summary_en.result: Temperature significantly influences cyclic hardening/softening behavior and dislocation substructure evolution.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing (fatigue) and microstructural analysis validated the findings.

papers.title: Day-case hip and knee arthroplasty: stages of care and the development of an institutional pathway
papers.abstract: Day-case, or outpatient, arthroplasty is growing and has been adopted in healthcare systems because of its cost-effectiveness. A number of studies that reported on day-case total hip arthroplasty, total knee arthroplasty and unicompartmental knee arthroplasty have shown that they can be performed successfully in a select group of patients. However, safety remains a concern, as a clear pathway, including discharge criteria, is not well described in the literature. This article outlines the stages of care involved in day-case hip and knee arthroplasty and gives insights from University College London Hospital's own evidence-based day-case arthroplasty pathway.

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文讨论的是临床日间髋膝关节置换路径，完全没有涉及生物力学分析、应力遮挡或微动等用户关注的核心问题。
llm.why_not_core: The paper describes a clinical pathway for day-case arthroplasty without any finite element analysis, stress/shielding quantification, micromotion modeling, or implant design evaluation—core elements needed for the user's hip implant biomechanics research.

summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，仅为临床路径描述

summary_en.motivation: This paper describes the development of an evidence-based day-case arthroplasty pathway for hip and knee replacements, focusing on safety and cost-effectiveness.
summary_en.method: The authors outline the stages of care and discharge criteria based on UCLH's institutional experience.
summary_en.result: A standardized day-case arthroplasty pathway is presented to guide patient selection and postoperative management.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper is a clinical pathway description without quantitative biomechanical assessment.

papers.title: Data-Driven Autoencoder Numerical Solver with Uncertainty Quantification for Fast Physical Simulations
papers.abstract: Traditional partial differential equation (PDE) solvers can be computationally expensive, which motivates the development of faster methods, such as reduced-order-models (ROMs). We present GPLaSDI, a hybrid deep-learning and Bayesian ROM. GPLaSDI trains an autoencoder on full-order-model (FOM) data and simultaneously learns simpler equations governing the latent space. These equations are interpolated with Gaussian Processes, allowing for uncertainty quantification and active learning, even with limited access to the FOM solver. Our framework is able to achieve up to 100,000 times speed-up and less than 7% relative error on fluid mechanics problems.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合深度学习和贝叶斯方法的降阶模型，能够显著加速物理模拟并提供不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的有限元代理建模。
llm.why_not_core: The paper validates only on fluid mechanics problems, not on solid mechanics or biomedical implant FEA, and does not address constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统PDE求解器计算昂贵，需要更快的替代方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出GPLaSDI框架，结合自编码器与高斯过程对潜在空间方程进行插值。
summary_zh.result: 在流体力学问题上实现高达10万倍加速，相对误差低于7%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证加速比和精度。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional PDE solvers are computationally expensive, motivating the development of faster reduced-order models.
summary_en.method: GPLaSDI trains an autoencoder on full-order-model data and uses Gaussian Processes to interpolate latent-space equations, enabling uncertainty quantification and active learning.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves up to 100,000x speedup with less than 7% relative error on fluid mechanics problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks of fluid dynamics problems.

papers.title: Second-Order Uncertainty Quantification: A Distance-Based Approach
papers.abstract: In the past couple of years, various approaches to representing and quantifying different types of predictive uncertainty in machine learning, notably in the setting of classification, have been proposed on the basis of second-order probability distributions, i.e., predictions in the form of distributions on probability distributions. A completely conclusive solution has not yet been found, however, as shown by recent criticisms of commonly used uncertainty measures associated with second-order distributions, identifying undesirable theoretical properties of these measures. In light of these criticisms, we propose a set of formal criteria that meaningful uncertainty measures for predictive uncertainty based on second-order distributions should obey. Moreover, we provide a general framework for developing uncertainty measures to account for these criteria, and offer an instantiation based on the Wasserstein distance, for which we prove that all criteria are satisfied.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于距离的二阶不确定性量化框架，但未涉及有限元代理模型或生物力学设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on theoretical uncertainty quantification for classification, with no application to surrogate modeling, finite element analysis, or biomechanical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有二阶分布不确定性度量存在理论缺陷，需要更合理的度量标准。
summary_zh.method: 提出一组形式化准则，并基于Wasserstein距离构建满足所有准则的不确定性度量框架。
summary_zh.result: 新度量满足所有提出的准则，优于现有方法。

summary_en.motivation: Existing uncertainty measures for second-order distributions have undesirable theoretical properties, motivating the need for a principled framework.
summary_en.method: A set of formal criteria for meaningful uncertainty measures is proposed, and a general framework instantiated with the Wasserstein distance is developed to satisfy all criteria.
summary_en.result: The proposed Wasserstein-based measure satisfies all criteria, overcoming limitations of previous approaches.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical proofs are provided; no experimental or numerical validation is conducted.
